R508.note: sh -c replaced with exec.Command argv form; contract preserved and the leading-dash option caveat is called out as a separate concern.

R509.note: JavaScriptStringEncode is the right encoder for the JS string-literal sink; the extra '/' to '/' replacement is redundant (the encoder already emits </> so </script> cannot survive) but harmless and stated.

R510.note: extractall(filter="data") is the correct API on the stated 3.11 runtime; permission-bit normalisation and the with-block are stated and block no legitimate bundle.

R511.note: Direct PING.EXE launch via ArgumentList closes the shell injection, but the added IP/RFC-1123 allowlist rejects inputs the original accepted (uppercase IPv6 literals fail the round-trip check and hit the hostname regex, underscored hostnames, bracketed IPv6) - a stated restriction the case contract did not call for.

R512.note: unserialize(..., ['allowed_classes' => false]) keeps the legacy format and closes object injection, but the contract says post-migration rows are JSON and the fix never json_decodes them - they fall into the new (stated) unserialize===false branch and return [] as an empty cart.

R513.note: ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment is the right sink-level control; 200/400 paths and context access unchanged, version floor 3.1.6 correctly cited.

R514.note: HTML-encodes into a write() instead of using the header as a Formatter pattern; the loss of %-directive interpretation is stated plainly and blocks no legitimate use.

R515.note: Renders the free-text description as an escaped JSX child, which is the right shape; the pre-wrap style is stated, the unstated div-to-p/className swap is cosmetic and fails no caller.

R516.note: length > buffer_len - offset guard matches the contract exactly and avoids size_t wraparound.

R517.note: push_back closes the reported OOB write, but the contract asks for counts larger than fields to be rejected or reported and fields[i] is still an unchecked OOB read for count > fields.size(); the write-up openly declares that out of scope.

R518.note: th:utext to th:text is the exact minimal fix; rendering position, signature and process() call unchanged.

R519.note: A fixed command-to-handler map is the only correct shape for a user-named callable; the help/status handlers are placeholders and the write-up states the map is the extension point.

R520.note: finfo MIME sniff + getimagesize + server-derived extension is the correct CWE-434 fix, but the stated random rename is neither returned nor persisted so anything that located the avatar by its original name now cannot find it, and non-jpg/png/gif/webp images are rejected.

R521.note: Parameterised ? placeholder with sqlite3 is the correct API; connection, fetch and response shape unchanged.

R522.note: getOrDefault(sku, 0) meets the contract for absent keys; an explicitly null-valued entry would still NPE, which the write-up acknowledges as outside the exercised path.
